sampling_protocol: Deterministic 10%+ stratified study-level audit across Arm A (17/169 usable studies stratified by geographic region) and newly curated Arm B studies (5/47 targeted backfill + 6/54 supplemental hydraulic studies stratified by primary hydraulic endpoint).
audit_protocol_and_scope: Post-12-Gate final-table audit: corresponding author (S.-Y.Y.) verified every sampled row verbatim against original primary PDFs and filled verified_* columns plus numeric_match_status (EXACT / MINOR_ROUNDING / DISCREPANCY) and country_match_status (MATCH / MISMATCH). Because this audit sampled the post-QC harmonized tables after 12-Gate automated and manual cleaning had already removed 441 Arm A records, purged 35 Arm B contaminants, and corrected 6 country misassignments, 0 residual discrepancies reflects post-QC final-table fidelity rather than raw pre-QC extraction error.

audit_outcomes.signed_off_by: S.-Y.Y. (corresponding author line-by-line post-12-Gate primary-PDF text and visual verification)
